note: macOS-generated golden vectors for the OnlyCue LTC decoder. The C# OnlyCue.Core re-implementation must reproduce every case exactly. Signals are recipes, not sample dumps: both sides build the same [Float] from the input fields, applying the mutations in the order documented on LTCDecodeGolden.samples(for:), and expect.sampleCount fingerprints the result. The five ops tap the pipeline stage by stage so a failure localises. To regenerate after a deliberate change, delete golden/ltc-decode-v1.json and re-run the suite.
